# Fiberglass

Fiberglass insulation is a tried-and-true method for
enhancing a building's thermal performance. Made from fine glass fibers, this insulation type is highly effective at trapping air, thus reducing heat transfer. It is available in
batts and rolls, making it a flexible choice for various applications.

# Rockwool

Mineral wool insulation is known for its exceptional fire resistance and sound absorption. Made from natural stone and recycled materials, it is an environmentally
friendly option that provides excellent thermal performance. Its density makes it suitable for a variety of
applications.

# Blow in Cellulose

Blow-in cellulose insulation is an eco-friendly choice made from recycled paper. This loose-fill insulation is
ideal for hard-to-reach areas to provide comprehensive coverage. Its ability to conform to irregular spaces ensures that every nook and cranny is insulated.

# Closed Cell Insulation

Closed cell spray foam insulation is a high-performance solution for those seeking maximum energy efficiency. This type of insulation offers a robust barrier against air
and moisture infiltration, making it ideal for both residential and commercial properties.

# Open Cell Insulation

Open cell spray foam insulation is a versatile and cost-effective option for improving your property's energy
efficiency. Known for its excellent soundproofing qualities, open cell insulation is perfect for interior walls and
ceilings. It expands upon application, filling gaps and creating a barrier against air leaks.

# Fire Blocking

Thermal barrier fire paint is an essential safety feature for any building utilizing spray foam insulation. This specially
formulated paint provides an additional layer of fire resistance, ensuring compliance with building codes and
enhancing overall safety.

# Who is Affordable Insulation?

Experts in home insulation solutions, helping families save on energy bills, boost comfort, and increase home value with quality and sustainability.
With an experienced team and high-grade materials, Affordable Insulation delivers personalized services focused on energy efficiency, lasting performance, and year-round comfort. Our mission is to turn your space into a more comfortable, safer, and cost-effective home — all year long.
Thermal Barrier Fire Paint: Adds crucial fire resistance when used with spray foam, enhancing safety and building code compliance.
Fiberglass: A proven choice made from fine glass fibers, it’s effective at reducing heat transfer and works in various applications.
Rockwool (Mineral Wool): Fire- and sound-resistant, made from natural stone — great for safety, sustainability, and thermal control.
Blow-In Cellulose: Eco-friendly loose-fill insulation made from recycled paper that fits tight spaces and provides full coverage.
Closed Cell Insulation: High-performance spray foam offering top-tier energy efficiency and moisture control — ideal for any property.
Open Cell Insulation: Flexible and budget-friendly, this spray foam expands to seal air leaks and offers great soundproofing for interiors.
At Affordable Insulation, we believe comfort, savings, and sustainability go hand in hand — and we’re here to prove it.
